title: San Francisco drew federal housing reimbursements before paying some capital costs

beats.text: Auditors could not check administrative cost limits in two San Francisco housing grant reports.

visual.sub: Two capital reports lacked the supporting calculation for administrative spending

beats.text: They had reviewed all six reports filed in 2017.
The next audit listed that issue as corrected.

visual.kicker: Two capital reports lacked the supporting calculation for administrative spending

beats.text: The 2017 test examined ten of twenty capital grant reimbursements.

visual.kicker: The Authority received reimbursements before paying some costs

beats.text: The Authority received federal cash before paying some underlying costs.

visual.kicker: The Authority received reimbursements before paying some costs

beats.text: Some payments went out more than two weeks after reimbursement.

visual.kicker: The Authority received reimbursements before paying some costs

beats.text: The 2018 audit tested 29 capital reimbursement claims.
One included payments made six days after federal cash arrived.

visual.kicker: The next audit identified another payment six days after the draw

beats.text: A separate closeout report was late under either date in the audit.

visual.kicker: The closeout date and the reported delay do not agree

beats.text: The printed dates imply 28 days. The auditor reported 38.
The following audit listed both controls as corrected.
